is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae s.l., including An. arabiensis and An. gambiae s.s. (M and S molecular forms) (p. 2-5).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Reports genotyping of Vgsc 1014F (L995F), 1014S (L995S), and ace-1R (G280S/G119S) (p. 6-8, Tables 2, 3, 4).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 gives sample sizes (N) and allele frequencies for 1014F and 1014S across sites, years (2008, 2009, 2010), and species. Table 3 provides explicit genotype counts (LL, LF, FF) for bioassay survivors and dead. Table 4 provides sample sizes and ace-1R allele frequencies.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquito larvae were collected from four sentinel sites in Burkina Faso (Goundry, Koupela, Kuinima, and Soumousso) from 2008 to 2010 and reared to adults (p. 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary research article presenting longitudinal 3-year surveillance data from Burkina Faso (p. 1-2).

sub_country_location.evidence: Four specific localities with geographic coordinates: Goundry (12° 30' N, 01° 20' W), Koupela (12° 10' N, 00° 21' W), Kuinima (11° 09' N, 04° 17' W), and Soumousso (11° 00' N, 04° 03' W) (p. 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquito collections took place twice per year between 2008 and 2010, and data are reported separately by year (2008, 2009, 2010) (p. 2, Table 2, Table 4).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The paper explicitly states that 'data from 2008 have been published previously [6], but are included here for comparison' referring to Ranson et al. 2009 from the WHO/TDR network (p. 2, 4).

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts, allele frequencies, and sample sizes by site, year, and species are provided in Tables 2, 3, and 4 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study reports 3-year longitudinal monitoring (2008-2010) of insecticide resistance and resistance marker dynamics (Vgsc 1014F, 1014S, and Ace-1 G119S) across four sentinel sites in Burkina Faso. Genotype frequencies and sample sizes are reported by species, site, and year, along with genotype-phenotype associations for WHO bioassays.
